title: Budgeting VRAM before you press Queue

questions.q: Why can you read a safetensors file's parameter count without loading its weights?
options: The header holds each tensor's type and shape as JSON at the start
It is always in the metadata field
questions.answer: The header holds each tensor's type and shape as JSON at the start
questions.why: An 8-byte length, then JSON, then raw data.

questions.q: Why is adding every file's size together a poor budget?
options: They aren't all on the card at the same time
Files are always bigger than memory
questions.answer: They aren't all on the card at the same time
questions.why: Models load when needed and are unloaded when room is needed.

questions.q: Your graph samples fine, then fails in the final node. What do you try first?
questions.why: The VAE's stage has its own memory need, and tiling is its cure.

questions.q: What should you try before moving to a smaller format?
options: Closing other programs and lowering size or batch
Removing the text encoder from the graph
questions.answer: Closing other programs and lowering size or batch
questions.why: Those are free or nearly so, and a smaller format can cost quality.

questions.q: How much bigger is a GB than a GiB?
options: A GiB is about 7% bigger than a GB
A GB is ten times bigger
A GB is 7% bigger than a GiB
questions.answer: A GiB is about 7% bigger than a GB
questions.why: 1024 cubed against 1000 cubed. 12 GB is about 11.2 GiB.

questions.q: The worksheet says your graph fits with 0.2 GB left. What now?
options: Run it and read the console: a thin margin needs a real test
Assume it works for all sizes
questions.answer: Run it and read the console: a thin margin needs a real test
questions.why: It is an estimate. Only a run gives you the real peak.
